blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sandiganbayan Third Division Chairperson Associate Justice Karl Miranda on Thursday scolded an official of the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) over her statements regarding the presence of an aide inside the jail cell of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez. This came after BJMP Jail Superintendent Maria Lourdes Pacion was once again summoned by the court to attend its hearing in relation to the current status of Romualdez inside the Quezon City Jail Male Dormitory.
